title: Control codes
description:
Build and take apart IOCTL codes with the `CTL_CODE` layout.

```
CTL_CODE(0x8000, 0x800, METHOD_BUFFERED, FILE_ANY_ACCESS) = 0x80002000
0x80002000 -> device 0x8000, function 0x800, buffered, any access
0x8000E00F -> device 0x8000, function 0x803, neither, read and write
```
hints: Methods: 0 buffered, 1 in direct, 2 out direct, 3 neither. Access: 0 any, 1 read, 2 write, 3 both.
requirements: `ctlCode(device, function, method, access)` = `device << 16 | access << 14 | function << 2 | method`.
Decode back into the four parts with shifts and masks.
Functions below 0x800 belong to Microsoft; warn about them.
stretch: Print a table of every IOCTL your echo driver defines.
